title: Research: UT3(F4) dependent central triple has exact minimum 12 (closes #2261 three-output question; no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Bounded formal minimum under priority revision 6, closing the three-output question left by [#2261](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2261). In `F_2[UT_3(F_4)]`, every word in the four involutions `X_1,X_w,Y_1,Y_w` with rank-one idempotent calls that realizes

```text
diag([Z_1], [Z_w], [Z_{w^2}])
```

on three registers, and the identity on every extra dirty register, has length at least **12**. The disjoint commutators `[X_1,Y_1]`, `[X_1,Y_w]`, `[X_w,Y_w]` attain 12 (`n_X=6`, `n_Y=6`). The six-call composite previously used for `Z_{w^2}` attains the same endpoint in **14** and is not minimal.

The lower bound is the nilpotent-corner rank count on the defining `6×6` representation: with coefficients in `{1,w}` only, `n_X≥6` and `n_Y≥6`. It is not an exhaustive search of length 11. Machine checks cover the group law (order 64, associativity), the 28 trace-1 idempotents, the nilpotent table, both schedules, a restored spectator, and all 12 single deletions of the short word.

**Scope.** Four involutions only. `X_{w^2}` and `Y_{w^2}` are unproved and can break the `{1,w}` summand split. This does not reopen the two-register minimum 8 from #2261. `12α` is a formal per-call price in this alphabet, not a supplier, hosting, or κ improvement.

**No new kappa.** Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`.

## Task and overlap

- Package: `research/ut3-f4-dependent-central-triple/`
- Tip: `713c28c1b0ebbdf3f30d7887fcb173e7a786f245`
- Base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`
- Scope: **changed** — exact three-output minimum, not a reprint of the two-register census

Closest prior: [#2261](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2261) (merged; two-register minimum 8; 14-call composite; explicit that the block search is not a lower bound for arbitrary words of length ≤12). Clear of open Q8 negative-target PRs, the odd-kernel tariff cascade, and flag-0 / stock / gate-operand leave-alones.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/ut3-f4-dependent-central-triple/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/ut3-f4-dependent-central-triple/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/ut3-f4-dependent-central-triple/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/ut3-f4-dependent-central-triple/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/ut3-f4-dependent-central-triple
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_UT3_F4_DEPENDENT_TRIPLE minimum=12 predecessor_direct=14 nX=6 nY=6 group_order=64 idempotents=28 spectator=1 omission_controls=12 no_new_kappa
PASS_UT3_F4_DEPENDENT_TRIPLE_INDEPENDENT minimum=12 predecessor_direct=14 witnesses=12,14 spectator=1 no_new_kappa
PASS_UT3_F4_DEPENDENT_TRIPLE_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=3
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/ut3-f4-dependent-central-triple outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Credit

Credit Cinna Davis / [#2261](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2261) for the two-register minimum, the fourteen-call composite, and the open three-output question, and the eumemic / woklerx rank-one idempotent register model. Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

1. Can `X_{w^2}` and `Y_{w^2}` reduce this triple below 12? The `{1,w}` summand split does not apply once `w^2=(1,1)` mixes the two `F_2` summands.
2. Can one of these twelve formal calls be embedded in a pinned bit supplier below the complete price of a rank-one factor? No legal physical realization is supplied here.
